prepare._source: our choice (JOURNAL 21:22, user approved): wiki groups = l2 classes chunked by 3,000 (l3-ordered); 252,000 MS passages = 84 x 3,000 = the largest main SE bank; 1,000 queries per out-of-scope source (= SE test size)

encode._source: P4/A0 retriever settings (queries with the query prefix, documents none). MS: bge-m3 for the main run (up to 84 chunks), the other models only the A5 size (30 chunks). Wiki: all groups for all models (also the second-encoder centroids). se_test_second: contriever embeddings of all 86 sites' test queries (second encoder of the main bge-m3 run for O-query centroids; A0 has contriever test queries only for the subset)

_runs_source: second = the A1 second-distance encoder (bge-m3 -> contriever, contriever -> Qwen3, Qwen3 -> bge-m3), used only for the topic moderator and the non-SE tiers (centroid cosines)

eval._source: our choices (JOURNAL 21:22 plan approved by the user; the matched-size rule below, the ms_n arm and the per-source thresholds are our choices, not in the plan: review 2026-10-07). Per KB the matched size n = min(|SE eligible| - 1, |wiki eligible|, ms_chunks) groups of 3,000, the same n for every O of the KB (SE eligible = sites other than the KB not excluded by the A14 site-crowd rule; for an SE O the O site is also removed; wiki eligible = wiki groups not excluded by the same rule with a wiki-specific common threshold, the 0.9 quantile of crowd(KB, group) over all KB x group; MS chunks are random and not filtered). Matched banks per draw d (R = 3): se_n (seed A15_se, KB, O, d: O-dependent because O is removed), wiki_n and ms_n (seeds A15_wiki_set / A15_ms_set, KB, d: shared by all O of the KB, so the bank-source contrast is paired across O sources). Full banks (deterministic): se_full = all SE eligible (= A14 excl all for SE O), wiki_full = all wiki eligible, ms_full = the first |SE eligible| chunks (the user's size-matched MS line; capped by the pool). Reference: flats_ms@0.5 on the 12,000-document P9 sample with the A2 seed (KB, O, d), d < 5 (= A13 for SE O; checked). Tiers: SE O = A1 tag tiers; non-SE O = tertiles over the run's (KB, non-SE O) pairs of the second-encoder cosine between the KB bank centroid and the O query centroid (high = near). Matched n also respects the Yahoo bank: n <= |Yahoo eligible| - the largest one-topic group count. se_n: one draw of n+1 sites per (KB, d), O dropped if present else the last (review 2026-10-07)

yahoo_bank._source: our choice (user asked for the Yahoo bank 2026-10-07): per Yahoo topic, 30,000 train questions (non-empty title; de-duplicated; titles equal to any Yahoo out-of-scope test title removed), seeded, document = question title + question content (the SE document form: title + body), 10 chunks of 3,000 per topic = 100 groups 'yahoo:<topic>#j'. For a Yahoo out-of-scope topic, the groups of that topic are removed from the Yahoo bank (as O's site is removed from the SE bank). KB-adjacency filter with a Yahoo-specific common 0.9-quantile threshold
